scope: Yggdrasil YGG-KNOW01 source-only independent research on existing PR #1327; canonical model/lineage owner remains Amalgam PR #1278; no original-world #426 first use, merge, native model changes, model deployment, new controller/scheduler/paid APIs.
question: Does an exact source-blind, two-step receding Bayesian intervention policy improve TERMINAL high-context expected Brier against strongest conventional entropy action selection with identical 6-map x 256-table posterior, witnessed-action budgets and deliberation-compute counted, where previous myopic EVI failed?

mechanism.base: Frozen KNOW26 JointHypothesis with all six anonymous action mappings and 256 truth tables, unchanged conventional Bayes update; each mapping group prior from previously consumed KNOW26 3x36 FIT. Held world law posterior uniform over 256; no hidden true law or map enters planner.
mechanism.two_step: At each t=0..30, select a maximizing g1(m,c,a)+sum_{y=0,1}Pr(y|m,c,a)*max_b g1(m after hypothetical one-observation update,t+1,b), with g1=exact reduction in mean high-context Bernoulli predictive Brier over c4..7 minus cost 0.002 for nonzero action; t31 select one-step g1. All hypothetical updates on disposable clones; only observed chosen real y updates persistent learner once.
mechanism.observational_source: Public c=t mod 4, action labels 0..3; action0 known no-op, action1..3 opaque to policy. Bernoulli p=.85 for private hidden law bit at c xor private mapping[a], else .15. Per-step private deterministic SHA256 coin independent of policy/action; no teacher inference, oracle labels or counterfactual outcomes enter learner.
mechanism.no_new_weights: Two-step planner only selects witnessed actions from same learned Bayes posterior, no new parameter/head/canonical learner; not new intelligence by itself.
mechanism.private_world_sampling: Each historical map-group's learned FIT mapping posterior samples one of six private action mappings with independent SHA256 domain; source-only assessor selects either a uniform 256-bit truth table or one of four specified three-input Boolean causal rules. The policy never receives the selected map, rule or private coin.

structured_shift.law: Round-robin seed-ordinal 4 rules: x0 XOR (x1 OR x2); x2 XOR (x0 AND x1); ((NOT x0) AND x1) XOR x2; (x0 OR x1) AND x2

held.matched_private_coins: SHA256('know30:private:coin:v1:'+cohort+':'+group+':'+seed+':'+t), first unsigned64 / 2^64; same counterfactual exogenous noise per t across arms but no unchosen-action reward delivered.
held.disjoint: New 160xx and 161xx seeds only, no 140xx KNOW27 or 150xx KNOW29 held re-use.

fairness.matched: fit_lookahead2 vs fit_entropy_compute_matched use SAME priors, learned 6x256 capacity, 32 observed actions/world, same public context sequence, price per nonzero intervention, and exactly 31 calls per world to two-step hypothetical branching; entropy compute-matched deliberately discards computed plan and selects entropy action to isolate the policy rule. Every hypothetical branch is disposable; only the actually chosen witnessed action is admitted.
fairness.extra_controls: fit_entropy_fast is strongest conventional operational baseline with less compute; fit_myopic_evi uses same prior but cheaper one-step EVI; nofit_entropy lacks the historical 108 per map-group FIT observations; privileged_correct_map_entropy gets true map and is ineligible as fair comparator.
fairness.costs: Measure wall_seconds for each arm separately, hypothetical_calls and source outcomes. Compute-match is equal algorithmic calls, not measured exact FLOPs/clock equality; report any runtime discrepancies and no speedup claims.
fairness.success_primary: Lower mean terminal analytic expected Brier (including intervention charge) is better; scores 4 high x2 contexts c=4..7 after 32 actual witnessed actions, evaluator only; no scorer reward in training.

predeclared_gates.H1: Two-step Bellman objective matches independent full two-reward posterior enumeration on an UNHELD synthetic prior, tolerance <=1e-10; no future reward leak, no private law/map in action API.
predeclared_gates.H2: Lookahead2 reduces prior-matched 18-world mean cost-adjusted final high Brier by >=0.005 vs fit_entropy_compute_matched.
predeclared_gates.H3: Lookahead2 reduces structured-shift 18-world mean net high Brier by >=0.005 vs fit_entropy_compute_matched.
predeclared_gates.H4: Lookahead2 reduces BOTH cohort net high Brier by >=0.003 vs FIT myopic EVI; no nonregression on either.
predeclared_gates.H5: Exactly 576 observed actions per arm/cohort, 72 evaluator-only high queries, 31 planner calls per world for each compute-matched arm, FIT historical actions reported separately, cold exact checkpoint and no replay/duplicate/hidden input.
predeclared_gates.classifications: Engineering pass requires frozen protocol, source-only controls, original Linux+Windows focused and complete final regression, native history compatibility, pinned exact-source atlas and a single new isolated one-shot prospective synthetic study. DEV_SUPPORTED only all H1..H5; DEV_MIXED if some of H2/H3/H4 hold; otherwise DEV_NO_GO. SCIENTIFIC_PASS forbidden for synthetic-only results.

first_use: No newly reserved cohorts generated or scored by source commit/test discovery. Existing repo workflow job may run source-only held experiment ONCE after focus, atlas, mandatory full final both OS and original history compatibility PASS. Never replay consumed held to improve science; preserve negative result and report if scientific run cannot qualify.
stop_conditions: Deny source_mode != engineering_fixture_only and any protected original-world calls; no post-result modification of seeds, source, threshold, scoring, action cost, model family, or policy to produce claimed win. No new controller, scheduler, owner runner or model promotion.
